item.title: Liquid vs Web API in Power Pages: Data Loading Performance
item.description: In this post, I compare the performance of Liquid and Web API in Power Pages when rendering large datasets. Based on real-world tests with 200, 2,000, and 10,000 records, I analyze which approach delivers faster page loads, better scalability, and a smoother user experience. You’ll also learn best practices for data filtering, server-side calls, and asynchronous loading to avoid common performance pitfalls.
